results.text: Effects of sodium zirconium cyclosilicate on the quality of life of patients with hyperkalemia undergoing hemodialysis: Y-QOL study design. Patients undergoing hemodialysis (HD) face severe dietary potassium restrictions, reducing their quality of life (QOL) and potentially worsening their prognosis. Sodium zirconium cyclosilicate (SZC) is a novel selective potassium binder that lowers potassium levels, with minimal effects on other electrolytes.
